title: Contrix Mention Redirect Content Block
description: cx.content.mention_redirect. Source-Realm stub for private agent invocation. The carrying Event MUST declare requirements.critical_extensions[] with id='cx.feature.mention_redirect.v1', scope='payload', fail_closed=true. See spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-workspace-profile.md §8.1.

body.description: Plain-text fallback / sender-authored disclosure summary. Visible to all source Flow members. Client MUST display 'visible to all members' notice in compose UI. Server MUST NOT generate or rewrite.

target_actor_id.description: Target agent DID. MUST be sender's controlled agent. Reducer validates via authority_grant_ref resolution.

authority_grant_ref.description: Active capability grant in source Realm whose attached_authority.controller == sender principal AND subject == target_actor_id.

redirect_pair_id.description: Opaque UUIDv7 generated by sender to correlate source stub with mirror agent_task. MUST NOT leak mirror Realm / Flow / Event IDs.
